synopsis:
The cheerful and open high school freshman, Nakazato Haruka has fallen in love! With his classmate - basketball's club Tajima Kaoru. Haruka started his fierce attacks, and also declared "You will like me for sure!" How will the cool and quiet Kaoru react after knowing about Haruka's feelings?

(Source: Peccatore Sanctuary)

title: Kakkou no Yume
synopsis:
A drama story about Natsuka, his best friend and his sex friend. Natsuka has been in love with his best friend, Hakushima, for four years without any gain. Though not wanting to stain his best friend and their friendship he never confesses. To divert his feelings from Hakushima, Natsuka embraces his sex friend, Seno, as a substitute. One day, Seno ends up running over Hakushima while on his motorcycle and this leaves Hakushima unconscious. Later, Seno wakes up saying "I am Hakushima." Natsuka comes up with the idea of embracing his sex friend who now has Hakushima's soul inside.

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title: Sumire Syrup
synopsis:
Sumire is habitually indecisive. Kei is brutally straightforward. And so begins a sweet, high school love story.

(Source: Keijo Shoujo Scans)

title: Devilish Romance
synopsis:
After being unfairly framed in devildom, middle-tier devil Sitri falls onto Earth as a human and searches for a serial killer who could take him back to his origin. He meets a stubborn, strict human boss who he initially hates; however, he eventually starts having feelings for her. Love has no limits, but... does it really? What will be their fate?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Nomi Joshi
synopsis:
The manga Nomi Joshi features three friends, all women aged 29, who get together and socialize regularly and indulge in their common passion: drinking. Michiko Takase, the office lady heroine, prefers beer; Misono Miyauchi, a short-haired, muscular book store worker, likes sake; and Yuki Shinonome, the feminine housewife, drinks everything. The manga follows them as they visit hot springs, beer gardens, bars and more to sample different drinks, pair them with delicious side dishes, and chat about work, their family, how to keep warm while wearing skirts, etc.

(Source: ANN)

title: Lonely Girl ni Sakaraenai dj - Marking
synopsis: This story focuses on Ayaka and Sora after graduation.

title: Reborn as the Enemy Prince
synopsis:
Imagine being kin to your sworn enemy.

Killed in battle while defending his country, Bern wakes up in the body of the enemy prince, Kalian, and vows to avenge his people. But between taming an abusive half-brother and surviving his mother's deadly web of intrigue, sweet revenge seems to slip further beyond his grasp at every turn.

(Source: Manta)

title: Zomviguarna
synopsis:
A world in which zombies prevail. Nat, a boy who's called a "Professor" travels with a mysterious girl. His goal, and Maggie's identity are...?!

(Source: MU)

2. Karen Arm-leg
3. Tsukihi Eternal
4. Shinobu House

synopsis: The daily lives of a short coffee shop manager and the café's waitress.

title: Umeko-chan wa Koishiteru
title_japanese: 呻子ちゃんは恋してる
synopsis:
Although he's tall and athletically gifted, Masamichi Oga is a boy best known for being a huge scaredy-cat. And recently, there's something that's got him even more on edge than usual... And that's him being haunted by what he's sure is the ghost of a girl who committed suicide at the school long ago, and still stalks its halls!

But, the truth is, the girl that Oga has been swearing up and down is a ghost that's out to get him is actually Umeko Sayama, a sweet and pure girl who is totally in love with him.

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)

title: Shireba Shiru hodo
synopsis: Mori-san has found a comfortable place to be in her friendship with Shinohara-kun, but can it stay that way forever? Are they really "just friends"? The more she knows, the more she realizes that things may not be as simple as they seem.

synopsis:
From Mangaupdates:
One day a young girl finds out that the boy she likes is going to transfer to a different school. The only one who knows how much she loves him is her diary.

title: Body yori Soul?
synopsis:
High-school student Sawatari has his usual customers and doesn't get emotional about it. So why is it that he always seems to let "that person" drag him around? a very short story. 

(Source: MU)

synopsis:
For Yuiko, she has no "freedom" whatsoever. Every single day, she's always been ordered around by her childhood friend, Aya, and her little sister, Chika, and she can't help but to obey them. Though, one day, she receives a love letter from a classmate! For some reason...Aya seems very annoyed by this. 

(Source: Intercross)

title: Hoshi no Usagi
synopsis:
The ever cool and manly Uito has a sweet, cutesy side he shows only to Sei...! They don't miss an opportunity to smooch whenever their parents are out, and work hard on their finals and part-time jobs so they can live together one day. It's no surprise they go wild on their graduation trip...! Who fell in love first? This story follows two childhood friends who spend their school days totally besotted with each other!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Chijou Saikyou no Otoko Ryuu
synopsis:
Karate fighter Raion Ryuu is so unflinchingly powerful that, during a sanctioned match, his strikes accidentally explode his opponent into piles of steaming meat. As punishment he dons a sutra-infused mask to suppress his horrific might and goes into hiding with his psychic sister, but the two are eventually hunted down by his ex-master and the fiancé of the man Ryuu killed. While their modus operandi would appear to be revenge, they follow divine instructions from up above—destroy Ryuu before he can awaken as the Antichrist! God himself has put out a hit on our masked hero.

(Source: MU)

title: Zoku Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Magian Company
title_english: The Irregular at Magic Highschool: Magian Company
title_japanese: 続・魔法科高校の劣等生 メイジアン・カンパニー
synopsis: The curtain has lowered on Tatsuya Shiba's turbulent high school life, during which he has defeated countless formidable enemies. He has now set in motion the realization of his new ambitions: The General Incorporated Association "Magian Company." The purpose of the organization to which Tatsuya was appointed the managing director of, is to implement protections to guarantee the human rights of magicians who possess a magical aptitude, yet are not able to reach a practical level. While being a college student, Tatsuya has steadily moved towards securing a new era where magicians can live as ordinary humans rather than as living weapons. For Tatsuya, whose influence has surpassed that of other Strategic-Class Magicians, the direction in which he has chosen to go has naturally attracted the attention of others from around the world. An assassin from the magician association "FEHR" in the USNA, is sent to investigate the direction Tatsuya has chosen to go... The curtain opens on the new l

title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon: Okomorigurashi no Fafnir
title_english: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Fafnir the Recluse
title_japanese: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン　お篭りぐらしのファフニール
synopsis:
Fafnir is a dark, brooding curse dragon from the same world as Tohru, Kanna, and their friends. He's also an otaku who's as obsessed with games, merch, and doujinshi as he is with gold, jewels, and destroying all humans. This latest spin-off from the popular Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid series follows Fafnir's daily life in a shared apartment with Kobayashi's otaku coworker Takiya, where Fafnir tries to get along with humans and dragons—or just avoid them!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Boku no Papa to Papa no Hanashi
title_japanese: ぼくのパパとパパの話
synopsis:
Meet Nao and Ai, a couple that has been dating since their university days. The legalization of same-sex marriage spurs them into taking the next step and formalizing their union, along with adopting Hiro, a newborn baby boy.

See how these two polar opposites handle sleepless nights, sending Hiro off to his first day of preschool, and managing relationships with other parents. They may even find that being a parent to Hiro teaches them more about themselves than they could have ever imagined...

(Source: Animate International)

title: Yume nara Doko made Yurusaremasu ka?
title_english: How Far Is My Dream Allowed?
title_japanese: 夢ならどこまで許されますか?
synopsis:
"I've killed someone, please arrest me!"

...is what he said as he rushed into the police station, but it was all just a dream. 27-year-old Kaga Mitsuki has just done something unspeakably embarrassing. Later, Kaga goes to the police station to apologize and is greeted by Seto Kenya, a young police officer who is kind and has great taste. Moreover, Seto tells Kaga, "If you have another nightmare and feel anxious, please come see me!" and they become closer and closer friends... At this rate, Kaga won't be able to resist falling for Seto! From then on, Kaga's nightmares turn into erotic dreams of Seto... An erotic and heart-wrenching romantic comedy BL featuring a young, dog-like police officer and a corporate slave!

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Shark
synopsis:
Sharks don't have lungs, but they do have to breathe oxygen to survive. Instead of breathing air, though, sharks get oxygen from the water that surrounds them. So they have to move around, if they stop moving for a while, they sink into the water and die, So Sharks have to move and move constantly from birth to death. The same goes for you. If you want to survive, keep moving, then you will be the best hunter... like a shark.

(Source: MU)

title: Ultimate Antihero
title_japanese: アルティメット・アンチヒーロー
synopsis: When humanity was threatened 5 years ago, the boy who saved the world was driven to despair and became regarded as the enemy of all of mankind. And now a new crisis approaches humanity. The curtain rises on a gallant drama about a hero falsely charged.

title: Imitation
synopsis:
Behind all the glitz and glamour, the world of showbiz is an unforgiving place. Idols must maintain their image at all costs: a single slip-up could bring their career to a crashing halt. Despite this pressure, the promise of fame and adoration is more than worth the risk for many.

Lee Maha is a member of the newly formed group Tea Party, and has attracted the attention of many by imitating popular idols. But this has also caught the disdainful eye of Kwon Ryoc—one of the most famous stars in the industry. Though he initially looks down on her, Ryoc gradually realizes his feelings for Maha may be something more. However, scandals can ruin any idol's career, and if the pair decide to entertain their budding relationship, they may just threaten the fame they have worked so hard for.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Double Hound
synopsis:
Searching for info on drug selling, ring leader Leaguer gets found out. Luckily, Yakumo, a call boy who was present at the time, helps him. Hoping to get more info, Leauger wants to get close to Yakumo, but things are never as innocent as they seem

(Source: Bunny's Scanlations)

title: Hakujin to Kurobotan
title_english: Naked Sword and Tree Peony of Black
synopsis:
Kengou Kuroi may be part of the Kuroguro group, but he cares greatly for the neighborhood he grew up in. He resolutely plans to keep his yakuza affairs as far away from it as possible. However, one persistent issue seemingly follows him around: his childhood friend, Touma Shirakaba, who brazenly confesses to Kuroi at every opportunity since Kuroi's inauguration as wakagashira—second-in-command of the yakuza—seven years ago.

Shirakaba's unwavering presence has since become a common sight at the group's base. His sharp features and fierce looks even cause the other members to forget that he is an ordinary citizen. By creating some distance between them, Kuroi tries to keep Shirakaba's hands clean. However, his plan soon backfires as Shirakaba voluntarily joins the Kuroguro group as its new legal advisor.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Yoroizuka-san wo Baburasetai
title_japanese: 鎧塚さんをバブらせたい
synopsis:
I want to pamper iron-masked Yoroizuka...!

Kurumi, a high school girl, fell in love at first sight with Yoroizuka, a level-headed company worker with such an iron mask of a face that she gets called a robot. Kurumi wants to hug and caress Yoroizuka, but as a cute little first-year high school student with no love experience, Kurumi finds it still too difficult...!? She wants to see the moment when that calm demeanor crumbles!

A moe girls' love story with an age gap☆

(Source: Galette Works, translated)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Girl Meets Bunny Girl

title: Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War
title_english: Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War
title_japanese: ファイアーエムブレム 聖戦の系譜
synopsis:
Based on the Super Famicom strategy game, Fire Emblem 4 features the son of Lord Byron of Chalphy, Lord Sigurd. Bandits from Verdane made an attack while Grandbell's armies were away, and now Sigurd rallies the remaining forces to drive the bandits out so he can save his friend, Edin... Little does he know what he leads himself into will lead into a tragic turn of events in the face of Grandbell.

(Source: The English Fire Emblem Documentary)

title: Death God
synopsis:
To avenge his older brother, an orphan named Jongli Chu killed Hwang Jung, a Heaven-Slaying Sect disciple. Following the death of Hwang Jung, he joined Imitating Blade Killer of Soul-Killing Chambers to avoid the pursuit of the Heaven-Slaying Sect. However, a huge mess called ten chastisements was waiting for him. To escape the shadow of chastisement, he has no choice but to become a legendary Death God! Can Jongli Chu become a Death God and find freedom in the stifling rules created by the orthodox sects?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Isekai Shachuuhaku Monogatari: Outrunner PHEV
title_english: Sleeping Overnight in My Car in Isekai
title_japanese: 異世界車中泊物語 アウトランナーPHEV
synopsis:
One young salaryman who adores his plug-in, hybrid car that uses both electricity and gasoline, had been using camping in it as an escape plan from everyday life. Suddenly, he finds himself transported to another world with his car! He'll start his life anew in this different world!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Cristo
title_japanese: クリスト―橙眼のメシア―
synopsis: Towa became a sweeper admiring the legendary sweeper called, “Orange-Eyed Messiah”. The task of sweeper, which requires to “sweep” the monsters Adys is quite hazardous. On his first real attempt at fighting Adys, Towa encountered Kei, a former sweeper who saved him from being killed. Towa asked Kei to take him as a student. However, not only Kei plainly rejects Towa’s request, he tells Towa that he saw the “Orange-eyed Messiah” die!? An appearance by a mysterious man who seems to be connected to Kei showed up with a grudge from the past. Who is he and what is his relationship with the “Orange-Eyed Messiah”? Will Towa finds out about Kei’s past too? (Source: M-U)

title: Koutetsu no Baby Leaf
title_japanese: 鋼鉄のベイビー・リーフ
synopsis:
Almost a year has passed since Tokio-sempai unexpectedly told Yousuke, a student and lover of plants, "I fell in love with you at first sight!" So every day, Yousuke is continually on the receiving end of Tokioâ€™s relentless attacks. The handsome Tokio, who is also a good student and successful with girls, harasses Yousuke daily, pushing him farther and farther away ... or maybe...

(Source: Girls' Generation Scanlations)

Included one-shot: Kamisama wo Yameru Toki

title: BLT: Burning Love Twin
synopsis:
Twin brothers, Nozomu (going to a school for delinquents)and Saku (class president for a prestigious school), decide to switch places for the day. Humor and misunderstanding ensue as Saku can't control his urge to get everyone in tip-top shape, and Nozomu only has one plan - to find out why the Sensei keeps calling his brother. But while Nozomu is trying to find Sensei, Saku is learning what best friends are really for.

(Source: MU)

title: Emperor Hunt
synopsis:
Mysterious glowing orbs appear in the sky all over Earth, rapidly sucking the age out of humans and the planet itself. As mankind regresses to infancy and ultimately disappears from existence, a lone woman stands unaffected with her most precious person slipping through her fingers. Seul Yun, a tortured experimental subject her entire life due to her immortality, suddenly finds herself in Earth's parallel dimension called Hetra.

Emperor Horson, a wicked and immortal woman who wiped out the Earth, appears to have extensive knowledge about Seul Yun. But Seul Yun is rescued from Horson's almighty hands by the former commander of Hetra's Royal Knights, Kasar Einante. As he convinces Seul Yun to unite against Horson, he teaches her about Hetra and its formidable driving force akin to magic. Now with the powers of Hetra hot on their heels, two people with nothing left to lose must find a way to overpower Horson and avenge those they have lost.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Cupid no Hatsukoi
synopsis:
His childhood friend, the archery girl, is a rival, an angel, and a cupid.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Dricam!!
synopsis:
"Drifting is a sport!" Rin Todoroki, a natural drifting genius, just wants to put driving aside and live out a normal, comfy university life. What will happen when she is confronted by the automobile club, or "auto" for short? Students who've put it all on the line... their stories start here!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Joryuu Sakka to Yuki
synopsis:
Young cafe worker Yuki dreams of romance and a life far more wonderful than her own, but has no way to do anything but hope for the future. But a chance encounter with the beautiful, mysterious authoress Beniko Azuma, a woman who seems to know love like the back of her hand, might change the very way she looks at the world...

(Source: Sexy Akiba Detectives)

title: Yashio to Mikumo
synopsis:
According to an old saying, all cats may start out with nine lives, but what happens when they begin to use them up? This story enters the secret world of cats, and begins where Yashio gives up one of his own to save Mikumo's life.

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Kare to Kanojo no Futoumin (His and Her Sleepless Winter)
Volume 2: Sateliter

title: Hoshigari na Kimi to Futsutsuka na Boku
title_japanese: 欲しがりな君と不束な僕
synopsis:
Consists of a collection of oneshots:

1) Covetous You and Insensible Me (Hoshigariana Kimi to Futsutsukana Boku)
Never one to get close to strangers, Kai finds himself helpess in the enchanting gaze of a foreigner...

2) Lost in the Darkness Before Dawn (Gyou An ni Mayou)
Tatsumi Hiroaki is a swordsman for hire during the Edo Period. Recently, a rise in bandit activity has given him a steady flow of work in protecting small shops in town. The bandits recognize his skill and offer to hire him, where he finds a familiar face from the past.

3) Confession (Kokuhaku)
Unable to forget the random act of kindness by the wealthy, but lonely business man, Matsumi offers to sell his body. Is it really just for money, or is there a greater need at stake?

4) The night he escaped death (Shi ni Zokonai no Yoru)
Prequel of Lost in the Darkness Before Dawn.

5) Sleepless Night
The Night He Escaped Death bonus.

6) Service
Confession bonus.

7) Bonds of Blood
Covetous You and Insensible Me bonus.

title: Hatsukoi no Itazura
synopsis:
A childhood promise made to meet again when they turn 16... Now that 10 years have passed, will my first love, Sei-kun, be the same as how I've remembered him all those years ago?

(Source: Intercross & Shoujo Crusade)

Included one-shots: Smile!, Hobby Hobby, Shou-Shou Space

title: Suki tte Iwaseru Houhou
title_japanese: 好きって言わせる方法
synopsis:
Cute and popular, Nanoka seems to be the type of girl who could get any boy using her so called "tactics". Accepting confessions and dumping at the snap of a finger, she's never been truly in love. Until now. How can she catch this sempai's attention when she can't keep herself composed enough to use her so called tactics?

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Aijou Ippon!!, Koi to Switchback, Pinpon dash Girl

synopsis:
1-2. Itareritsukushite! (Service Me Good!)
3. Joushi ga Bitch ni Natta no wa Danjite Ore no Sei ja Nai (It's Not My Fault My Boss Became a Bitch)
4. Bitch no Joushi ga Hageshisugite Komaru (My Bitchy Boss Is Too Relentless, It's Troubling)
5. Kawaikusuru kara Motto Choudai (I'll Be Cute So Give Me More)

title: Osananajimi no Ijou Kawaii Imouto-chan

title: Melting Point
synopsis:
After twelve years, a former teammate—no, a thorn in his side—suddenly reappears. Eunsan isn't thrilled to be working with Ian again, having long buried both his ice hockey past and any memories of him.

Unlike Eunsan, who hopes their meeting will be a one-time thing, Ian insists on keeping him around with an offer he can't refuse. With his beloved younger sibling caught in the middle, Eunsan reluctantly agrees, but he can't shake the feeling that Ian has an ulterior motive.

Why does Ian keep pulling him closer? There's no way this guy actually has feelings for him...right?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Rookie Chef with the Magic Touch
title_english: Rookie Chef with the Magic Touch
synopsis:
Seonghoon Kang has been the cook's helper at Jewelria, a third-rate hotel, for years, causing his self-esteem to plummet lower than his standing in the kitchen. However, he has a secret that makes him a cut above the rest... he can see the "memory" of an ingredient with just one touch! The sear of the kitchen may scorch the meek, but can this rookie chef survive the heat and prevail over the grueling struggles of life? Or should he just get out of the kitchen for good?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Wakeari Shinrei Mansion
title_japanese: 訳アリ心霊マンション
synopsis:
Kaoru Shinonome, who had been living as a freelancer, invests her inheritance in property and buys a vast old condominium. Her dream life as a wealthy landlord is about to begin—but there are no living tenants, only spirits, and her new property is a rollercoaster ride of psychic phenomena. Kaoru embraces her new specter-filled life as the owner of Ghost Mansion and starts recruiting for new non-living residents!

(Source: Titan Comics)

title: Afterglow
synopsis:
Higuchi Kiyotaka has hit rock bottom. Once a promising doctor on his way to becoming a cardiovascular surgeon, a traumatic incident has forced him to relocate to a rural town in Kyushu where he's relegated to practicing general medicine. Each day is a struggle to communicate with his heavily accented patients and overcome his intense feelings of guilt and depression. After an evening spent drinking himself into a stupor, he has a fateful encounter with a mysterious yakuza named Tenju, who promises to help the young doctor forget all his troubles for a night. As Higuchi finds himself drowning in unknown pleasures, he can't help but wonder—just who exactly is Tenju? And what does he want from him?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Solo Sex
synopsis: Though he's a High School senior, Takitani works as an escort named Ryou. To escape being caught, Takitani does his best to remain inconspicuous in school. But one day a classmate suddenly shows up as his customer. The son of a doctor, Kunimi is a total prick who's always picking on Takitani. Anxious not to be caught, Kunimi is completely oblivios to Takitani's disguise and becomes smitten with his cute and cool attitude. Takitani tries to push him away so they don't become too intimate, however... [from Baka-Updates]

title: Rex: Kyouryuu Monogatari
synopsis: Chie is a young girl with wonderful parents to look up to; her archaeologist father lives with her in Hokkaido, and her mother is a great scientist working in America. During a local cave excavation, Chie and her father discover Tyrannosaurus eggs, and they're about to hatch! This little girl becomes their mother, and does what she can to protect them from those who want to experiment on the little baby rex.

title: Gingitsune
synopsis:
Gintarou is a fox spirit that has been protecting the small Inari temple since the Edo era. Saeki Makoto's family possesses the power to see the gods' agent, but the ability is limited to one living relative at a time. When Makoto's mother passed away while she was still young, Makoto inherited the ability as the sole remaining family member. With the help of fox spirit's power, Makoto and Gintarou help the people of their community, in spite of their many differences.

(Source: MangaHelpers, edited)

title: Mokke
synopsis:
"This is a story about two sisters: Shizuru is a high school student who is able to see ghosts while her younger sister, Mizuki, is haunted by these apparitions. Frustrated by their abilities, their parents decided to entrust the sisters into the care of their grandparents who live in the countryside. As they adapt to life in the countryside, Shizuru and Mizuki begin to learn about the importance of coexisting nature with these apparitions."

(Source: ANN)

title: Chikyuu Kanrinin
synopsis:
15 years ago, the newborn Ukai Nanoha and her mother were involved in a plane crash. The mother was killed and the child alone, among all of the passengers, survived. This survival was brought about thanks to the Great Demon Maou, who replaced her unbeating heart with one of his own, allowing her to live on.

Now, however, Maou has appeared once again and attempts to force her to return his heart. In the end, Nanoha goes to live in Mezon Aasu (Earth Mansion) which exists solely for the use of magical beings, and for now at least, retains possession of the Great Demon Maou's heart...but how will she be able to handle being manager of Earth Mansion, the place in which Maou himself makes his residence?

(Source: MU)

title: Vanilla Star
synopsis: Ever wonder what happened to Takeshi, the poor side character who got dumped by Sahara in The Man Who Wouldn't Fall in Love? Takeshi is the main character in Miyamoto Kano's newest manga. Heartbroken and lonely, Takeshi turns to internet porn for comfort, where a new AV actors catches his eye. He tries to find more about the boy, desperate to meet him. But the road to love is never rockier than when the object of your affections is in the porno trade... (from Liquid Passion)

title: Femme Fatale: Unmei no Onna
title_japanese: ファムファタル～運命の女～
synopsis:
The term "femme fatale," or "deadly woman," is a stereotype of an alluring woman who charms her lover into an insatiable desire for her, and draws them into dangerous situations. Its Japanese translation means "the fated woman." In this thrilling romance, Saitou Hajime joins a club at his college and meets the "femme fatale," Yukari Ebisawa, a graduate student who loves donuts and has quite a quirky personality—and a boyfriend. However, their relationship soon becomes complicated, interfering with their friends, work, and club duties...

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Horobiteyaru. (I'll Destroy You)

title: Hetare Venus
title_japanese: ヘタレ女神（ヴィーナス）
synopsis:
1. Hetare Venus
2. 1 day, 1 kiss
3. Tsuki ni Todoku Tou
4. Yami e Hakobu Elevator

title: Izanai: Hyakunen no Koi
synopsis:
After a long shift at the coffee shop, barista Sevi takes in a seductive vampire named Hornet! But when their one-time tryst turns into a torrid affair, Sevi's feelings come rushing to the surface. Can a human truly care for a creature of the night? Izanai: Hyakunen no Koi follows gorgeous vampires as they frolic and feed without restraint! No mortal or monster can predict the instant when their pulse will race at the sight of a brand-new mate…but when the end is imminent, is it worth it to fall in love?

(Source: Digital Manga, Inc.)

title: Aa toka Uu shika Ienai
title_japanese: あーとかうーしか言えない
synopsis:
A reticent rookie artist and an editor desiring plot (and not just "plot") team up to take on the eromanga industry together. Chaos and cohabitation ensue.

(Source: MU)

title: Hottarakashi Meshi
synopsis:
At 25, Fuuko's true love isn't romance; it's food. Her path to cooking begins with a lucky bingo win—a nifty rice cooker! But with her kitchen occupied by her pet hermit crab, Hikki, Fuko has to get creative... Cooking with only a rice cooker?! Challenge accepted! Join Fuuko as she steams ahead in this lazy gourmet adventure!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Roid
synopsis:
"I'm jealous of you..."

A girl from a robot club in a wheelchair, Futagami Yui, looks up to heroes and wants to create one, so she enlists the help of an underclassman, the talented A.I. architect Kazumiya Reina, to build an android together. When it's almost finished and only the A.I. needs to be sorted out, someone kidnaps Reina. Yui curses her inability to do anything because of her legs and resolves to perform an illegal "mind copy" to save her junior...

This is the log of adolescence of girls living in a world where humans and androids coexist.

(Source: MU)

title: Seijo ja Nakatta node, Oukyuu de Nonbiri Gohan wo Tsukuru Koto ni Shimashita
title_japanese: 聖女じゃなかったので、王宮でのんびりご飯を作ることにしました
synopsis:
Rina, who came to another world by summoning a saint is surprised at the unpleasant taste of rice. Even the royal palace has this taste...? "I will make it myself, so lend me a kitchen!" Freed from the role of a saint, Rina grabs the hearts and stomachs of the royal family with delicious food!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Noble Lady Reformation Guide
synopsis:
Aristocratic young ladies are either rude and ill-mannered, or have nothing but flowers in their heads. Even in an era when talk like that was aplenty, there was someone who taught them. A commoner named Derrick realized he has talent for magic and made a name for himself as a mercenary. One day, he was invited to become the magic tutor for aristocratic young ladies. Thanks to Derrick, the star lecturer who turns those rude young ladies into a "proper person," prestigious noble houses start bombarding him with offers.

"There's no such thing as a bad young lady in the world."

At least, not in front of Derrick.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED: Astray
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED ASTRAY
synopsis: Whereas the main story of Mobile Suit Gundam SEED focuses on the struggles between the Earth Alliance, ZAFT, and Orb Union, the Astray series is focused on the three MBF-P0x mobile suit prototypes (however mainly on Lowe Guele) and their respective pilots and organizations, who mainly exist on the outskirts of the main SEED storyline. The MBF-P02 Astray Red Frame is piloted by Lowe Guele of the Junk Guild, and the MBF-P03 Astray Blue Frame is piloted by Gai Murakumo of the mercenary group Serpent Tail. The third Astray, MBF-P01 Astray Gold Frame, is piloted by the primary antagonist of the Astray story, Orb nobleman Rondo Ghina Sahaku, and later by his twin sister Rondo Mina Sahaku.

title: Amagami: Close to You
title_japanese: アマガミ close to you
synopsis: Another Amagami serialization in Comp Ace magazine. This version features Sakurai Rihoko as the main heroine.

title: Daten no Tsuki
synopsis: A young man, Rukis, has left Eden and wanders the desert until he collapses and awakens in a strange mansion. There he meets the master of the house who has rescued him. Rukis reveals the true reason for why he was thrown out of Eden and learns that the master of the house may share a similar past. As the two open up to each other, Rukis and the master begin to develop a steamy relationship. (Source: BLU Manga)

title: Shin Tekken Chinmi
synopsis:
In the previous "Kung-Fu Boy" series, Chinmi became the master of Kempo at Dairin temple, where he trained disciples. When they lose contact with Kyorinji, a temple of the same sect, Chinmi is dispatched to the Kanan Autonomous region to investigate.

He tries to enter Kanan with Pushin, a swordmaster whom he met traveling to Kanan. But they are attacked after trying to enter Kanan and pursued by the Border Police who chase them into a waterfall. A fisherman saves them and aids their entrance into Kanan. The people of Kanan are forcibly oppressed by the government. Chinmi befriends the people and makes the big decision to free them with his Kempo. Sorabi Boru, Lieutenant of the Border Police and Jirai, the evil king of Kanan attack Chinmi...

(Source: Manga-Sketchbook)

title: Haneikyuu Happy End
title_japanese: 半永久ハッピーエンド
synopsis:
Nanako Kobayashi, a 17-year-old teenager, has an ugly face who seems to not have a care for the world. One day, she got a call, only to be given two choices to answer a question. A devil suddenly appears, taking the form of her teddy bear. The devil is willing to grant her three wishes, each based on two options. What wishes will Nanako choose?

(Source: MU)

title: Ubunchu!
synopsis:
Based on the Linux operating system variant Ubuntu, this "slapstick school comedy," three high school students—the fervent UNIX user and club president Akane Kisaragi, the hardcore gal-game otaku vice-president Masato Midou, and the doujinshi-drawing Mac fan Risa Shiina—are learning how to use Ubuntu in their systems adminstration club.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kataomoi x Kataomoi
synopsis:
1-3. Kataomoi x Kataomoi
4. Kimama ni Kuchizukete Douzo
5. Motto Zuruku Kawaigatte yo

title: Last Summer Vacation
title_japanese: ラストサマー・バケーション
synopsis:
Ayumi Umino has always looked up to people like Mizuki Otonashi; even with a terminally ill mother, Mizuki has managed to top their class in both popularity and kindness, to the point of not revealing that Ayumi cut class to drink alcohol. One day, Ayumi is approached by Mizuki's friends and asked to return Mizuki's painting set to her—despite her dark attitude toward the shallow girls, Ayumi accepts as a way to repay Mizuki's kindness.

However, as Ayumi arrives at Mizuki's house after taking a shortcut, she sees something she was never supposed to—Mizuki stepping out of a car, covered in blood and carrying a knife. Ayumi feels death creep near as Mizuki approaches her, but is surprised when she is instead invited inside for tea. She nervously accepts, now a witness to murder and scared for her life, but is curious about this side of Mizuki normally hidden from the public.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Devilman Mokushiroku: Strange Days
title_japanese: デビルマン黙示録STRANGE DAYS
synopsis: A side-story to Go Nagai's manga "Devilman" and "Amon: The Dark Side of Devilman". The tale of some teenagers in a rock band who become devilmen and get involved in the war with the demons.

title: Kanojo wa Mada Koi wo Shiranai
title_japanese: 彼女はまだ恋を知らない
synopsis:
I always see her. For her, I can do anything. I am a hopeless man. I can no longer endure this kind of normalcy.

(Source: Chibi Manga)

title: Kanjuku Summer End
synopsis: Tae helps with her family's tomato field. However, when Gen, a ruffian-looking boy from Tokyo, is sent to help with the field, it seems that a sweet love will also be ripening.

In this small town, within the 49 days after a person dies, you can see the dead's spirit. She once admired this small town where you can still spent time with the ones precious to you within these 49 days, but...

Included one-shots: Soko ni Koi Ari, Kimi wa Nanimo Hoshigarazu

title: Haitoku no Finale
synopsis: A cute girl named Moe finds a lesbian sex cult.

title: Koori no Kiss de Toroketai
title_japanese: 氷のキスでとろけたい
synopsis:
Sugimura Nozomi made a pact with her childhood friend Hyoudo Rei who both have a passion for ice-skating that when they grow up,they will both pair up to get into the olympics.But then Rei moves away.


Years later, Nozomi transferred to a school famous for its students' emphasis on ice skating.There she unexpectantly meets up with Rei only to find him indifferent to ice skating. But Nozomi will not give up on her dream even if Rei has and she's determined to make it to the school ice-skating club and bring Rei with her as her partner.

(From Shoujo Crusade)

title: Junjou Karen
synopsis:
Tamiya, a student whose honesty tends to be so blunt that it gets him in trouble, has fallen in love with Shirasaka, a teacher from his school. He's an excellent teacher, very caring and popular among students, but because of his dark past, there seems no hope for Tamiya to win over his heart. In the past, Shirasaka had a relationship with Iogi, his senior on the track team, and they were both in an accident which was Shirasaka's fault. Iogi became seriously injured and was forced to give up his athletic dreams. Since then Iogi has used Shirasaka's guilt to keep him close. Is there any chance for Shirasaka and Tamiya to be together?

(Source: Storm in Heaven)

title: Koishite Nanbo!
synopsis:
Anri goes after boys like there's no tomorrow. While going after her current target, Morio-kun, she accidentally gets involved with a moody glasses guy Kiriya. Realizing her opportunity, she tries to force him to go out on a double date with her and Morio-kun. While trying to convince him, Anri finds out that Kiriya has a target of his own, and she wants to help him obtain love!

(Source: Nagareboshi)

title: Idol♥Kiss
synopsis:
The most popular group of idol. Hina loves the leader of the group, Chiaki. After their representation, she was so exiting that she come to see Chiaki. And they kissed!! Then, they started going out together. But Chiaki designed her as his "pet". Hina is so happy but will she support being only a "pet"...?!

(Source: Chibi Manga)

title: Hunter Academy's Invincible Martial God
synopsis:
Humanity's once peaceful world was turned upside down when monsters suddenly emerged from a portal in the sky. When all hope was lost, special people with powerful abilities called "attributes" appeared—they called themselves Hunters. To survive, humanity turned to education, creating academies to produce the best Hunters. Though his attribute is low-level, Yusung Shin is determined to rise to the top of Gaon Academy—the best Hunter Academy in the world.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Nishi no Yoki Majo
title_english: The Good Witch of the West
synopsis:
Firiel is a 15-year-old girl who lives with her father, the astronomer Professor Dee, and their servants, the Holys. When she is invited to a fancy ball at a count's castle, she discovers that her past is more complicated then she had thought. A necklace given to her by her father proves that she is of royal blood—and a candidate to be the next Queen!

(Source: MU)

title: Oshi no Bishoujo ni Kokuhaku sareru Hanashi
title_japanese: 推しの美少女に告白される話
synopsis: A yuri romcom manga where an otaku is confessed to by the pretty girl she declares as her oshi and they start dating.

title: Gyakuten Saiban Official Anthology Comic: Mitsurugi-hen
title_english: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Official Casebook Vol.2 - The Miles Edgeworth Files
title_japanese: 逆転裁判 オフィシャルアンソロジーコミック 御剣編
synopsis: An anthology of shorts made by various doujinshi artists and published by Capcom.

title: Love Sweat
synopsis:
High school art club member Yuu doesn't like to get his clothes dirty when he's painting, so he just wears his apron, oblivious to the effect it's having on his roommate, Shouji. What will happen when Shouji is no longer content to only watch Yuu?

(Source: MU)

title: Yongbi Bulpae Oejeon
synopsis:
A mysterious stranger rides into town. The peaceful village of Gang-Ho is disturbed when Yongbi, a seemingly foolish bounty hunter, comes to town looking to claim the bounty for the leader of Gang-Ho's deadliest clan of assassins. Will Yongbi collect the bounty unscathed, or will he fall victim to a vengeful pack of assassins hell-bent on retribution for their captured leader?

(Source: Kissmanga)

title: Junk Land
title_japanese: JUNK LAND ジャンクランド
synopsis:

title_japanese: ブラッククローバー 暴牛の書

title: Chouritsu Soukou Zyklus;Code
synopsis:
Musical instruments have minds and bodies, feelings and thoughts. When tossed aside and abandoned, they can become corrupted, even murderous. Petrauchka is an instrument unlike the others; she can't make music at all. After she's found by the mysterious Rentarou in a trash heap, they must team up to calm a despairing lute and perhaps reveal the secret to Petrauchka's lack of musical ability. Can Rentarou somehow unlock her latent talents?

(Source: Fallen Syndicate)

title: A Match Made in Mana
synopsis:
Lilienne Islar died an abusive mother, a neglected wife, and a cast-off stepsister. So when she suddenly opens her eyes again as her younger self, she decides to set things right with the people in her life. Luckily, her stepbrother's a secret softie who's easy to win over. Her fiancé, on the other hand, is a magic-powered war machine doomed for insanity. With an illness draining her mana daily, will Lilienne have the strength to save her future husband and maybe even the whole empire?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Seventeen Syrups
title_japanese: セブンティーンシロップス

title: Sengoku
synopsis:
Mounted warriors line up and rush to the assault. Brandishing swords on horseback, the warriors slash at each other... This kind of image of feudal combat is all a lie. Well, then, how did Samurai really fight? A declaration of war has now been made against the lie of combat that was forged during the Edo period, and continued uncontested to this very day.

(Source: Illuminati-Manga)

title: Love & Action
synopsis:
A short romantic story about an actor and his stunt man.

(Source: MU)

title: Tsurezure Nichijou Ekotoba Colourful Bleach
title_japanese: 徒然日常絵詞 カラフル ブリーチ

title: The Gwichon Village Mystery
synopsis:
Heo Mumyeong is a cold-blooded serial killer. Following his latest murder, he disposes of the evidence and decides to move to his late grandmother's home in Gwichon Village. From the moment he approaches the village, the atmosphere is unnerving. Strange and hostile individuals question his identity and reason for coming, and his grandmother's house has been oddly well-maintained. The villagers seem to want the apathetic outsider gone, while burying dark truths and worshiping the mysterious "Mother." Mumyeong does not believe in ghosts or shamanism, but the violence, death, and creepy rituals prove that something far worse than him is watching.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shinyaku Seisho
synopsis: The story of Jesus Christ told through Manga.

title: Yurusarete Inai Watashitachi
title_japanese: ゆるされていない私たち
synopsis:
A collection of three one-shots by Sakurakoji Kanoko.  

Yurusarete Inai Watashitachi:

Is love between adults and high school girls really taboo? Ritsuko's boyfriend, Yuuji, is an outstanding office worker who works in a foreign company. He always treats Ritsuko like a little kid just because he is seven years her senior. Does Yuuji really like me? Ritsuko is always insecure. Do I really like Yuuji? Can we really be together? (Source: M-U) 

Winter Garden:

Taiyou and Daichi, identical twin brothers, and Aya were childhood friends who spent their time in a greenhouse, which they named "Winter Garden".  But a tragedy strikes one day, which changes their lives forever, and now two years later...

Yoru ga Akeru Made:

Minori has a crush on Kanno-kun, but rumor has it that he has just started dating someone new.  Depressed, she goes home to be comforted by her beloved black cat, Night, but he is nowhere to be seen.  Instead, she finds a strange boy wearing dark clothes who claims to be Ni

title: Cooking Papa
synopsis:
The story revolves around a salaryman (Kazumi Araiwa) who can cook well. He shares his love of cooking to his friends, co-workers, and family.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Hanamachi Monogatari: Hatsuzakura Mau, Yoru no Shitone
title_japanese: 花町物語 －初桜舞う、夜の褥－
synopsis:
Shuri is bought by Toujou Tatsumi, owner of the brothel "Hanabishi". Thinking he's saved from the mistreatment at his previous workplace, Shuri gladly follows Toujou only to find out that he might have fallen into the clutches of an even worse employer.

Based on the same-titled BL game.

(Source: MU)

title: Jinsei Hensachi 48 no Koukousei ga Kamisama ni Narimashita.
title_japanese: 人生偏差値48の高校生が神様になりました。
synopsis:
Atsushi is a descendant of the guardian deity of the Heian period. While his beautiful childhood friend, Yuki, is the daughter of the shrine erected to protect his family. But what Yuki doesn't know is Atsushi has a geass-like ability to obey whatever command he wants! Can Atsushi be able to restrain his urges?

(Source: MU)

title: Stretta
synopsis:
1-2. Boku wa Benkyou ga Dekinai
3. MBJ: Mizuho-san Chi
4. Issen
5. Bed no Nukumori
6-7. Aruiwa Mononoke

title: Yari no Yuusha no Yarinaoshi
title_english: The Reprise of the Spear Hero
synopsis:
Summoned to another world to serve as the Spear Hero, Motoyasu Kitamura is a pitiful young man who eventually finds himself only able to love filolials. But after being fatally injured in battle, Motoyasu wakes up yet again in the exact circumstances of when he was first summoned. It turns out that his spear possesses an ability known as Time Reversal! With his stats unaffected by the reset, Motoyasu decides to fight once more. His motivation: to once again see the smile of Filo, the filolial that he loves more than any other! Could this be considered the start of a new game in god mode?! The long-awaited otherworldly redemption fantasy begins!

(Source: One Peace Books)

title: Kemono Asobi
synopsis:
Tsubasa, the distinguished son of a famous musician, has a secret BDSM kink that he struggles to comes to terms with. When he chances upon Masaki, a man who meets people with his fists, will Tsubasa finally be able to understand his own desires?

(Source: MU)

title: Return of the King of Hell
title_english: Return of the King of Hell
synopsis:
Yama, the King of Hell, chooses retirement in search of happiness, but his reincarnation is put on hold when his successor, Harry, abandons his post to pursue a mysterious goal on the human plane. With the aid of the undertakers, humans who can draw forth the power of the Underworld, Yama attempts to quell the chaos and return everything to its rightful place. Will Yama tread the cycle of rebirth without faltering, or will the echoes of his past haunt his journey? One thing's for sure—there will be hell to pay.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Yumemigaoka Wonderland
title_japanese: 夢見が丘ワンダーランド
synopsis:
Kotarou is a middle-school boy living a mundane life without dreams. His only distraction is to chat with a lively high-school girl he calls "Miss Akogi," who plays the guitar in the street. After a UFO suddenly crashes in the middle of the city, the world around them starts changing in unexpected ways. Suddenly, everything seems possible...

(Source: Mangadex)

title: The Investor Who Sees the Future
synopsis:
After experiencing an accident in the military, Kang Jinhu gained the ability to foresee the future. He decides to use this ability to invest in various companies and make money, aiming to become the world's number one investor. How far do the limits of his foresight extend? Beyond investments, it touches economics, politics, corporations, and even global affairs. From now on, he's reshaping the world of finance!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Gyakuten Honey
synopsis:
One day, Kengo Yagami found some of his classmates teasing a turtle that lived behind their school—and he beat them up. But when the turtle spoke, he was so shocked that he kicked it as hard as he could. Unfortunately, the turtle was actually a god, and as punishment, he switched Kengo's body with his childhood friend Mitsuka's, and their new bodies are causing both of them a lot of trouble at school...

(Source: Which Scanlations)

Included one-shots: Kirakiraboshi no Ana, Kimi wa Boku no Saboten

title: Overlord: Koushiki Comic à la Carte
